title: Scorecard, p-n splitting, and binding under-prediction for the derived mass formula
html:
categorical scorecard at q_0 = 1.1099785955541805\ldots (50 dps; CODATA-2018 muon pin, per the deprecated witness derived-only-formula.witness.json):

See Table 1.

Proton-neutron mass splitting: \Delta\mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{n}-\mathfrak{p}} = 1.293332 MeV matches CODATA exactly (preserved by inter-gen direct convention, since free nucleons have \Phi = 0).

Binding under-prediction. The same formula systematically under-predicts nuclear binding energies by 30\% to 76\% across light isotopes:

See Table 2.

The under-binding pattern reveals a structural omission: the formula misses an intra-shell binding mechanism present in nature. Closing the gap universally requires a new derived term rather than phenomenological patches.
